correctness.rationale: The proof independently derives the exact Erlang-vs-Erlang vaccine/infection event-race probability, uses the source descendant reward convention, verifies strict log-concavity of both complete-tree descendant counts and negative-binomial cumulative sums, and proves all adjacent crossing endpoints/monotonicity. The one-stage first-layer theorem, two-stage branching cutoff, exact binary height-four threshold, and rational witness follow rigorously, including equality boundaries and arbitrary positive rates. Exact rational verification checks 1,920 finite parameter families using an independent dynamic programming race recurrence. Sampled code is supplementary, not a substitute for the general proof.

value.rationale: An explicit and natural vaccination target-location optimization problem remains nontrivial because proximity to an infected root increases descendants protected but decreases immunization success. For every balanced branching factor, finite height, Erlang stage count and two positive rates, the proof provides a full and interpretable global switch-phase classification, ties included; the sharp two-stage binary-tree transition shows a distributional modeling choice can reverse the selected level at fixed mean vaccine time. This extends beyond a tiny numerical gain or reformatting of a known table, and supplies a reproducible exact benchmark while excluding unrealistic generalizations.
